text:
maria: quick heads up — i'm about to merge a refactor that splits the networking + payments tf modules. i moved service account bindings into `modules/payments/iam.tf` and added a k8s annotation mapping for secret paths. can someone do a fast sanity check on the secretpath wiring and provider compatibility? :eyes:

shawn: pinging @kevin and @lisa for tf + k8s manifest eyeballs. what's the provider situation? did you change any provider blocks?

maria: no provider block changes in the refactor PR itself, but the module split surfaced a couple implicit provider usages (helm provider in the k8s manifests). i left a note in the PR with the snippet:```hcl
module "payments" {
  source = "./modules/payments"
  secret_path = var.payments_secret_path
}

resource "kubernetes_manifest" "svc" {
  manifest = file("templates/payments-svc.yaml")
}
```

kevin: ok. two quick checks: 1) ensure the module has `required_providers` in its root module so it doesn't inherit unexpected provider versions, 2) confirm the `secret_path` variable is passed through to the k8s template rendering (looks like you use `redwood.com/secret-path` annotation). can you paste the manifest annotation?

maria: here's the YAML snippet i added to the template:```yaml
metadata:
  annotations:
    redwood.com/secret-path: "${var.secret_path}"
```

lisa: small thing — terraform templating inside YAML needs `templatefile()` or rendering via helm. are you using `templatefile("templates/payments-svc.yaml", { secret_path = module.payments.secret_path })`? if not, the manifest will contain the literal interpolation.

maria: good catch, i used `templatefile` in the module now. updated the PR to call `templatefile` and pass `secret_path = var.secret_path`. also added a note about the helm provider being optional.

kevin: on provider pinning: prefer adding `required_providers { kubernetes = { source = "hashicorp/kubernetes", version = ">= 2.7, < 3.0" } }` in the module root so it’s explicit. if the root config uses a newer kubernetes provider, that mismatch can break manifests.

shawn: also check the lockfile: splitting the module may change the dependency graph and `terraform providers lock` will output a new .terraform.lock.hcl. Did you regenerate it?

maria: i didn't regenerate the lockfile in the PR because i wanted a quick review first. i can run `terraform providers lock -platform=linux_amd64` and push the lock update after we confirm var wiring.

deploy-bot: CI check — formatting, validate, and plan kicked off for PR #4567 (maria/refactor-module-split). status: running.

kevin: sounds good. If you want a fast unblock: 1) add `required_providers` to the module, 2) confirm `templatefile` usage, 3) run `terraform plan` and attach the plan output for infra folks to glance at. after that i'll do a quick provider-version scan and LGTM if no surprises. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks. i'll push the provider block and run the lock/plan now. will post plan output here once done.

lisa: once plan is up i'll also grep manifests for `redwood.com/secret-path` usage across other modules to ensure naming is consistent. small follow-up PR ok if we need to rename annotation.

maria: plan attached in PR — no provider diffs except the lockfile addition. moving forward to regen lockfile and push. thanks all! :shipit:
